name: Chicken Lollipop
subtitle: frenched chicken winglets fried crisp and tossed in a red chilli glaze

ingredients.note: ask the butcher to french them
1 for the marinade, 1 for the glaze

ingredients.qty: 4, soaked 20 minutes and ground with 2 tbsp water
500ml for frying, plus 2 tbsp for the dip

prepNotes: Marinate the winglets at least 2 hours ahead, preferably overnight in the fridge. This is the whole flavour of the dish.
Soak the dried red chillies in hot water for 20 minutes and grind them to a paste before you start frying.
Take the chicken out of the fridge 20 minutes before frying, and pat the pieces dry so the coating grips.
These are deep-fried. Have a paper-lined tray ready and a slotted spoon to hand.

steps.text: Mix the winglets with the ginger, garlic, 1 tsp kashmiri chilli, the chilli powder, soy sauce, 1 tbsp vinegar, the pepper and 1 tsp salt. Refrigerate 2 hours.
steps.tip: Score the meat once through to the bone on each lollipop so the marinade reaches inside.

steps.text: Add the beaten egg, 4 tbsp cornflour and the maida to the marinated chicken and work it into a thick clinging coat.
Heat the oil in a kadhai to 170C. Slightly cooler than usual, so the meat on the bone cooks through before the crust burns.
steps.tip: If the oil is too hot the coating darkens in 2 minutes while the joint is still pink at the bone.

steps.text: Fry six lollipops at a time for 7 to 8 minutes, turning, until deep red-gold and firm. Drain on paper.
Raise the heat to 190C and give all twelve a 1 minute second fry. Drain again.
For the dip, heat 2 tbsp oil, add the ground red chilli paste and cook 2 minutes until the oil separates and the raw edge is gone.
Add the grated tomato, sugar, remaining 1 tsp kashmiri chilli, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt and 100ml water. Simmer 6 minutes to a thick, spoonable sauce.
steps.tip: It should mound on a spoon. Too loose and it runs off the lollipops.

steps.text: Either serve the dip alongside, or toss the hot lollipops in it for 30 seconds for the sticky restaurant version.
Wrap the bared bones in a twist of foil, scatter the spring onion greens and serve at once.

storage: Best straight from the kadhai. Fried lollipops keep 2 days refrigerated and re-crisp in a 200C oven for 10 minutes; the dip keeps a week in a jar in the fridge.
